nm:output.nm:control_stream:
$PROBLEM EDS50 Model Visual Acuity $INPUT C ID TIME DOSEQ MDV DV $DATA ed50s_fit.dat ignore=@
$PRED MU_1=LOG(THETA(1)) MU_2=LOG(THETA(2)) MU_3=LOG(THETA(3)) MU_4=LOG(THETA(4)) MU_5=LOG(THETA(5))
IF(MDV==1) THEN DOSE=DOSEQ ELSE DOSE=DOSE ENDIF
VA0=EXP(MU_1+ETA(1)) KK=EXP(MU_2+ETA(2)) BETA=EXP(MU_3+ETA(3))
EMAX=EXP(MU_4+ETA(4)) ED50=EXP(MU_5+ETA(5))
EE=EMAX*DOSE/(ED50+DOSE)
IPRED=VA0+(1.0-EXP(-KK*TIME))*(EE-BETA*VA0) Y=IPRED + EPS(1)
$THETA 55.0 ;[VA0] 0.005 ;[KK] 0.2 ; [BETA] 30.0 ;[EMAXS] 150.0 ;[ED50S]
$OMEGA 0.07 0.5 1.0 0.17 0.49 $SIGMA 28.0
$EST METHOD=1 INTERACTION MAXEVAL=999 PRINT=1 NOHABORT $COV MATRIX=R PRINT=E UNCONDITIONAL
